text.name: Maastricht Treaty
text.rules: Record "union founded" for the rest of the game. LIO spends 1 point on actions. Until the end of this turn, each time LIO spends points, it spends 1 more.
text.history: The Treaty on European Union was signed at Maastricht on 7 February 1992 and entered into force on 1 November 1993, creating the European Union and the path to a single currency.
